Messages.Author: Mathias
Messages.Body:
Kevin M. wrote:
>
> BEST CCG: "VTES" (write-in)
>

While I wholeheartely support White-Wolf and your efforts to give them
positive recognition, just wanted to make sure everyone realized that
this particular vote will probably be ignored as explained in this
reminder from the top of the page you linked to:

"You can only vote for products released in 2005. So you can vote for
something like the Kindred Most Wanted expansion for Vampire: The
Eternal Struggle for "Best CCG Expansion," but not the Vampire CCG
itself since it debuted in 1994."

> BEST CCG EXPANSION: "VTES LEGACIES OF BLOOD" (write-in)
>

This however, is a perfectly acceptable vote, and one which I went
ahead and wrote in. Though I believe the format they're looking for
would be as follows:

Legacies of Blood (Vampire: The Eternal Struggle CCG)

Not trying to be an ass about it, just concerned that if the write-in
votes aren't consistent they might not be tabulated together. As an
internet survey it will probably be tabulated by machine, and you could
end up with VTES LEGACIES OF BLOOD, VTES LoB, and Legacies of Blood
(Vampire: The Eternal Struggle CCG) each having separate votes. I know
it seems obvious they're all the same, but honestly I've seen it happen
before on similar web based "Best of..." polls.

> BEST MAGIC PRODUCT: "VTES" (write-in)
>

All right, well, I guess we all know this is just to thumb our noses at
them anyhow, so the validity of it doesn't really matter!

> BEST MINIATURES PRODUCT: "RACER KNIGHTS" (write-in)
>

Haven't played it myself, so I chose to abstain on this one in favor of
those who actually play miniatures.

Noticed a couple other categories some may want to use to further
support WW though:

BEST RPG: Mage: The Awakening

Personally, I was very impressed with what they did in the new Mage, so
it easily got my vote.

BEST RPG SUPPLEMENT: Lancea Sanctum (Vampire: The Requiem)

This is the only WW product listed in the category, but I think they've
had several excellent supplements this year. So I'd suggest either
vote for your favorite, or we can all get behind the Sanctified, just
to present a united front of support for the company.

BEST CARD GAME: Pimp: The Backhanding

I own it and love it, and if you don't you should! Pimp is a serious
blast, and a great laugh. I can't wait for the first expansion. I
need more Pimps and 'Ho's!

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:
> Fabio Ciccone wrote:
> > All this made me wonder: whats the difference between CCG and Card
> > Game? I mean, isn't Pimp the Backhanding colletible?
>
> P:tB is a fixed-deck game, like Uno, San Juan, Hearts, and
> Texas Hold 'Em.

Going further, since hardly any Card Game ever gets released in here
(that's why local CCG players are used to call them "card games" also):

Card Games have no collectible nature. You can order a single P:tB deck
and up to 4 players can use it. Think of it as a regular deck of cards
for poker or something similar - there's no point in buying another
unless you have more than one table of players at the same time, or
your previous copy of it has gotten unusable by too much wear or the
loss of a card.

best,

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo
